tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search sample flights by origin and destination (IATA or city). Returns an object {sampleData, dataset, flights: [{id, airline, airlineCode, price, seats, from, to, via, durationMinutes, currency}]}. Use result.flights; flight identifier is id. Results are sorted by price ascending and exclude sold-out flights by default; availableOnly:false includes them. Baggage must be looked up separately. Sample data, not live availability.

from.description: Origin IATA or city, e.g. BLR or Bengaluru

to.description: Destination IATA or city, e.g. SYD or Sydney

maxPrice.description: Exclusive upper price bound in INR

availableOnly.description: Return only flights with seats by default; false includes sold-out fixtures

tools.name: get_flight_details
tools.description: Read complete details for one sample flight including its itinerary and baggage allowance.

flightId.description: Sample flight ID returned by search_flights

tools.name: compare_fares
tools.description: Compare and sort the total INR prices of specified sample flight IDs.

tools.name: get_baggage_policy
tools.description: Look up included checked baggage kilograms and cabin baggage for a sample flight ID. Returns {sampleData, flightId, checkedKg, cabinKg, includedInFare}.

flightId.description: Sample flight ID returned by search_flights

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Read available sample seats and availability for one flight ID.

flightId.description: Sample flight ID returned by search_flights

tools.name: get_airline_details
tools.description: Read the sample airline directory by carrier IATA code, e.g. AI, MH, TG or SQ.

tools.name: get_airport_details
tools.description: Read the sample airport directory by IATA or city name.

tools.name: get_cancellation_policy
tools.description: Read sample cancellation rules and fees for a flight ID.

flightId.description: Sample flight ID returned by search_flights

tools.name: get_refund_policy
tools.description: Read sample refund eligibility, fees and processing days for a flight ID.

flightId.description: Sample flight ID returned by search_flights

tools.name: get_layover_details
tools.description: Read sample stopover airports and connection durations for a flight ID.

flightId.description: Sample flight ID returned by search_flights
